faq.q: What is the origin of Aqsa?
faq.a: Aqsa is associated with Arabic. Aqṣā ('farthest'), as in al-Masjid al-Aqṣā, the mosque of the Night Journey mentioned in Qur'an 17:1.
Yes — the underlying form أقصى is Arabic.
Aqsa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
